zh-CN.title: 科研任务与汇报协作
items: 课题采用紧凑单行导航，重绘里程碑时间线，科研奖励支持新增与逐项编辑
日期统一使用连续月历，支持 1900–2099 年与年月跳转；下拉选择统一采用友间组件
修复手机端弹层遮挡，讨论支持二级回复、可编辑 BONUS 奖励及原评论跳转

en.title: Research tasks and reporting
items: Compact project navigation, redesigned milestone timelines and individually editable research rewards
A shared scrolling calendar covers 1900–2099 with month jumps; selections consistently use Frienden pickers
Fixed mobile overlay ordering; discussions support threaded replies, editable bonuses and source-comment links
